full_judgment: "13.3.91: The complainant and her engaged Advocate are present by filing hazira. It appears from order dated 31.10.90 that the opposite party took an adjournment on that date. On 5.1.91 the opposite party was absent without taking any step, although he was duly notified by registered post about that date fixed for hearing of the case. On 3.1.91 the complainant was personally present before the tribunal but the hearing of the case was adjourned due to the absence of the opposite party without any step. A petition praying for time appears to have been left with the Bench Assistant but there was none to move it. The Tribunal noted this fact on the order sheet dated 3.1.91 and adjourned the hearing of the case for affording an additional opportunity to the opposite party to defend himself, fixing 13.3.91 at 4-15 PM for hearing. It appears from the postal receipt that notice has been duly sent to the opposite party by registered post in due course of business well in advance intimating the opposite party about the hearing of the case to-day at 4-15 PM. Registered service has a presumption that the said notice has duly been received by the opposite party but he has chosen to remain absent for reasons not known to us. The conduct of the opposite party prima facie appears to be irresponsible and reprehensible. We are satisfied that action under Article 51 of the Bangladesh Legal Practitioners and Bar Council Order and Rules, 1972 is justifiably called for against the OP and he be suspended from practice pending disposal of the case. The opposite party Mr. Majiruddin Ahmed, Advocate, be suspended from practice till the disposal of the case. This order of suspension comes into force at once. Let a copy of this order be sent at once to the District Judge, Dhaka, the Registrar of the Supreme Court of Bangladesh and the Secretaries of the Supreme Court Bar Association, Dhaka and the Dhaka District Advocates Bar Association for their information. Let the opposite party be informed. Fix 7.5.91 at 4-15 PM for hearing of the case. Notices by registered post be sent to the complainant as well as to the opposite party intimating the date of hearing of the case."
